content.text: For question 8 I'll ask the store for the shortest walk from Kestrel Farms (C-4) to Ostrava Machining (C-5) over the declared relations.
The store walks the steps as a chain, so I'll instead give every step a depth starting at 0. That makes it one walk over all the relations, which is what a shortest-path search needs.
I'll confirm question 9 in the store with an anti-join: products that have no order line pointing at them.

I answered all nine questions from one snapshot of the store, so every answer below reflects the same data. The store has 6 customers, 4 suppliers, 11 products, 12 orders and 27 order lines, and none of them are retired.

**1. Orders placed by Harbor Supplies (C-2)**
| Order | Date | Total | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| O-1002 | 2026-08-11 | 372.00 | shipped |
| O-1006 | 2026-09-09 | 142.50 | open |
| O-1011 | 2026-10-13 | 144.00 | cancelled |

**2. Products on order O-1007**
- **P-21 Check valve DN25:** 2 units (line L-1007-1)
- **P-40 O-ring set:** 8 units (line L-1007-2)

**3. Suppliers of the products on order O-1004**
| Line | Product | Supplier | Country |
|---|---|---|---|
| L-1004-1 | P-20 Ball valve DN25 | S-2 Lago Valvole | IT |
| L-1004-2 | P-40 O-ring set | S-4 Torino Guarnizioni | IT |
| L-1004-3 | P-41 Gasket DN25 | S-4 Torino Guarnizioni | IT |
| L-1004-4 | P-10 Hex bolt M8 | S-1 Nordic Fasteners | SE |

So three suppliers make these products: two in Italy and one in Sweden.

**4. Open orders with at least one valve**
The only valve products are P-20 and P-21.
- **O-1004:** P-20 × 10
- **O-1007:** P-21 × 2
- **O-1009:** P-20 × 4

O-1002 and O-1003 also contain valves, but both are shipped, not open.

**5. Orders and totals per customer, all statuses**
These come from the store's own count and sum, which match the order list.
| Customer | Orders | Total |
|---|---|---|
| C-1 Delta Metals | 3 | 1,653.00 |
| C-2 Harbor Supplies | 3 | 658.50 |
| C-3 Brightwater Utilities | 2 | 2,611.50 |
| C-4 Kestrel Farms | 2 | 247.00 |
| C-5 Ostrava Machining | 2 | 1,035.00 |
| C-6 Vale Hardware | 0 | 0.00 |

Vale Hardware has placed no orders. The store's grouping leaves it out, so I added it from the customer list.

**6. Units ordered per category, leaving out cancelled orders**
Two orders are cancelled and are excluded: O-1005 (P-30 × 1) and O-1011 (P-40 × 12). I added these up by hand from the lines, because the store can't group order lines by product category in one query.
| Category | Units | Products |
|---|---|---|
| Fasteners | 4,490 | P-10: 640, P-11: 1,350, P-12: 2,500 |
| Seals | 163 | P-40: 33, P-41: 130 |
| Valves | 25 | P-20: 20, P-21: 5 |
| Pumps | 14 | P-30: 3, P-31: 11 |

Check: all lines total 4,705 units, minus 13 cancelled units, gives 4,692, which equals the sum of the four categories.

**7. Order lines ranked 6 to 10 by quantity**
I read this as one page of five rows, sorted by quantity (highest first, ties broken by line id) and starting at the sixth row. Ranks 1–5 are L-1008-1 (1200), L-1001-3 (800), L-1010-1 (700), L-1001-1 (400) and L-1001-2 (400). There's no tie across the rank 5/6 or 10/11 boundary.
| Rank | Line | Order | Product | Qty |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6 | L-1012-2 | O-1012 | P-12 | 300 |
| 7 | L-1006-2 | O-1006 | P-11 | 250 |
| 8 | L-1006-1 | O-1006 | P-10 | 200 |
| 9 | L-1004-4 | O-1004 | P-10 | 150 |
| 10 | L-1012-1 | O-1012 | P-10 | 90 |

**8. Shortest link between Kestrel Farms and Ostrava Machining**
My first query was refused because it treated the steps as a chain, one after another. I reran it so all the relations could be walked in any order, and the store returned this 6-hop path:

Kestrel Farms (C-4) ← placed order O-1012 ← line L-1012-2 → product P-12 Washer M8 ← line L-1008-1 → order O-1008 → placed by Ostrava Machining (C-5)

In words, both customers have ordered Washer M8. It's the only product they have both ordered, so no other route is as short.

**9. Products never ordered**
- **P-13 Threaded rod M8** (fasteners, supplier S-1)
- **P-42 Shaft seal 30mm** (seals, supplier S-4)

I confirmed this in the store by asking for products with no order line pointing at them.
